title: The Two Claims of the Cloth Reliquary

bible.title: The Two Claims of the Cloth Reliquary
bible.kernel: A fort orders a band to recover a relic from the old woods. Two shrine keepers claim it and the woman carrying it may join the company.

cast.name: Nanette
cast.who: fort steward who tends the sanctuary and arranges outside recoveries for the garrison.
cast.want: to have the relic returned to the fort's sanctuary

cast.name: Folcuuara of the Ford
cast.who: keeper of a Ford shrine on an old wood ford, sworn to a single rite and quick to guard its claims.
cast.want: to claim the relic for her shrine and carry out its rite

cast.name: Alcmene
cast.who: wandering woman from the Western Forests who cooks for travelers and keeps small charms close.

bible.situation: Two shrines in the Western Forests both claim a single cloth-wrapped relic. The company's fort wants that relic returned to its sanctuary and has sent a steward to hire the company to fetch it. One shrine keeper, Folcuuara, claims the relic for her ford. The relic is now carried by a woman living in the deep woods, who travels with a rough meal-cloth and trades small favors for food. The land between the shrines and the fort is old growth and slow to cross.
bible.goal: To recover a sacred relic from Elderfold Clearing and return it to the fort's sanctuary.
arc: Search Elderfold Clearing, the ground the steward named, using the steward's directions → yields: a strip of worn elven linen stitched with the Ford knot and a thin trail heading toward Glassford Ford

Follow the linen's trail to Glassford Ford and parley at the shrine, using the strip as proof of passage → yields: Folcuuara of the Ford, who refuses to yield and says the relic was carried farther into the woods toward Hollowroot Hollow

Track the direction Folcuuara named into Hollowroot Hollow to find the woman who took the relic, using Folcuuara's claim as lead → yields: Alcmene, carrying the relic wrapped in a rough meal-cloth and willing to bargain for food and a place to stay
Bring Alcmene and the relic back to the fort's sanctuary the steward named, while Folcuuara arrives to contest the handover. Settle the claim there
tensions: Folcuuara will contest any handover and may follow to the fort to press her claim
Alcmene will not travel empty-handed and demands food and a place before she moves
The old-growth wood delays movement and frays the company's supplies and patience
openDirections: If the company delays, the two shrines may bring followers to the fort and force a public claim or skirmish over the relic
bible.stakeIfLost: The fort's sanctuary bowl will stand empty and the pilgrim offerings that buy the fort's winter grain will stop coming.
bible.arrival: came in wet through · spoke low, and only to the boss

shipped.title: Search Elderfold Clearing
shipped.situation: A fort steward, Nanette, came in wet through and spoke low to you. She wants the relic returned to the fort's sanctuary, the coin comes at the finish with the pick of what the job turns up. She says the sanctuary bowl will stand empty and the pilgrim offerings that buy the fort's winter grain will stop coming. She asks that Elderfold Clearing be searched using the steward's directions. A Ford priestess, Folcuuara of the Ford, will press a claim to the relic for her shrine and carry out its rite. Nanette sets things straight while talking.
shipped.job: Search Elderfold Clearing using the steward's directions.
